story_sequence.text: Beacon freezes external skill sources as first-class capability sources.
`core-skills/baoyu-skills` is formalized as the canonical sample source for this line.
users can declare business goals and target outputs without predeclaring the full skill chain.
Beacon defines capability selection and composition semantics.
success, failure, fallback, and human adoption outcomes are written back as learning evidence.
Beacon defines `task-type -> skill-chain -> output-shape` as a reusable learning mapping.
external skill governance preserves existing truth, guidance, and runtime boundaries.
external skill admission preserves strategy philosophy, minimum complete tools, and necessary factual grounding instead of collapsing into rigid step scripts.
